question: After being munched on by the juggernauts in arc 2, Beako said that the threads of the curses had become tangled. Is it possible that, if someone who could see was looking, the threads of the curses could completely hide someone’s form, so they couldn’t be seen?
answer: Beako was just using threads as an example; the threads of the curses weren’t actually tangled. What’s become of the curses, and what effect they’re having on Subaru, will be handled around arc 5.
